name: Taking Over Her Heart!
source:
I have a crush on my best friend, Amelie.

I have a crush and I am so scared to ruin what we have.

...So scared that I'll probably never tell her that I love her.

 Not unless someone helps me.

...Will (you) help me?

Taking Over Her Heart! is a short Kinetic VN about going on lots of cute dates with one very cute girl! Will (you) be able to take over her heart?

[From [url=https://porksbun.itch.io/taking-over-her-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我迷恋我最好的朋友艾米丽。

我很迷恋，我很害怕毁掉我们所拥有的。

…很害怕我可能永远不会告诉她我爱她。

 除非有人帮助我，否则不会。

……（你）会帮助我吗？

占领她的心！是一个简短的Kinetic VN，讲述与一个非常可爱的女孩进行许多可爱的约会！（你）能占领她的心吗？

[来自[url=https://porksbun.itch.io/taking-over-her-heart]itch.io[/url]]
